en: Welcome back down. That climb is over, but the tower will be here whenever you're ready to try again.
Your Pokémon are rested and ready.
Back from the roof! What a climb. Let me see to your Pokémon.
There you go. They're rested and ready.
Welcome to the Trainer Tower! Eight floors of trainers stand between you and the owner on the roof.
Would you like to take on a challenge?
Your Pokémon are rested. The clock is running from now on. Good luck up there!
You're in the middle of a climb! The trainers upstairs are waiting for you.
The tower is open to Champions of Kanto. Come back once the League has crowned you.
Each floor has trainers waiting: one with two Pokémon, a pair with one each, or three in a row with one each.
Their Pokémon are as strong as your strongest. Your Pokémon aren't healed between floors, so take care.
Reach the roof, and the owner will tell you your time. The quicker the climb, the better.
Come back whenever you feel like a climb.
I keep the tower's records. These are your best times.
